name: tri45sq
comment: The 45-45-90 triangle plus BOTH squares its edges generate: the unit square (four legs) and the sqrt2 square (four hypotenuses). Edge types 'S' = 1, 'H' = sqrt2; only like types glue. The two squares carry the SAME angle word, 90-90-90-90, and differ only in their edges — which is exactly what the unit-edge alphabet could not express, and the sharpest test of edge types there is: without them the two squares are one tile and the sqrt2 square cannot exist at all. Angles in D=24 units: 90 = 6, 45 = 3.
